blocks.text: The words “police officer” shall not be used in any advertising or upon the premises within the limits of the City and County occupied by the private security firm, nor on any of its vehicles or equipment. (Ord. 18137 § 6, 12-2-03. Code 1981 § 34-171. Code 1995 § 30-400.)
